 Renishaw inVia Qontor Raman Microscope 
Equipment Information
 Category
 Spectroscopy and Calorimetry 
 Location
 2224 HH Dow
 Quantity
 1
Description
Raman microscope with 532 nm and 785 nm lasers installed. Leica optical system with x5, x20, and x50 objectives. Fully motorized stage with software control. LiveTrack focusing provides 3D mapping and chemical identification of uneven samples. Raman spectra library available to identify samples.
Specifications
Lasers: 784.8 ± 0.5 nm NIR, 120 mW nominal power; 532.1 ± 0.3 nm Green, 50-150 mW nominal power
Detector: 1024 x 256 pixels
